text:
alex_chung: Starting deployment window for release/2026-03-20. Rolling API v4.1.0, runtime v2.3.1, router v3.2.0, console v1.10.0. Canaries scheduled 09:30-10:00 UTC.

nina_park: Copying preflight checklist here. Confirming DB migration is deferred (no schema changes).

sam_gate: +1. Runtime config change is KV cache eviction tweak only. No model format updates.

deploy-bot: deploy:init: queued 2088881234 for release/2026-03-20 by alex_chung

alex_chung: Plan: 10% canary -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m observation at each step. Router change is minor header rewrite.

jordan_pm: Product note: console feature flags 7 and 8 enabled default. If we see UI latency > 200ms, rollback console only.

tim_ops: Heads-up: EU region currently at 75% capacity for Dedicated pools. We'll route EU canary to us-east as fallback if capacity hit.

nina_park: Verify compatibility matrix: API v4.1.0 requires runtime >=2.3.0 and router >=3.1.8. We have runtime 2.3.1 and router 3.2.0 so OK. Console uses stable API surface.

sam_gate: Adding specific rollback gates:
- Runtime error rate > 1.5% over 5m -> rollback runtime to v2.3.0
- API 5xxs > 0.8% over 10m -> pin API back to v4.0.7 and route traffic to fallback region
- Router mismatch or header errors -> immediate router pin to 3.1.12
- Console JS errors > 2% -> disable feature flags and rollback console to v1.9.8

alex_chung: Also we agreed: if any one of API/runtime/router hits its rollback gate we do NOT auto-rollback the others. We rollback the failed service only unless cross-service trace shows cascading failure.

deploy-bot: deploy:canary: started canary 1 at 2088881270 (10% traffic)

nina_park: Running smoke tests: auth flows, streaming endpoint, embed endpoint. Posting results in 5m.

sam_gate: Added temporary metric alert: runtime_kv_miss_rate spike -> alert to #eng-oncall and this thread.

deploy-bot: metric:runtime_kv_miss_rate=0.6% (baseline 0.2%) at 2088881298

tim_ops: That's within acceptable cushion, keep watch.

nina_park: Smoke tests passing: auth ok, streaming OK, embed perf +5% latency but within SLO. No errors in traces.

alex_chung: Advance to canary 2 (30%) in 3m unless any escalations.

deploy-bot: deploy:canary: advanced to 30% at 2088881325

deploy-bot: deploy:promote: v4.1.0 API pinned for region us-east at 2088881340

sam_gate: Observability note: watch KV cache hit ratio and per-token latency on runtime for 15m after 30% step. Put retention on detailed traces for this run.

nina_park: Noted. Allocated extra trace retention for 30m.

jordan_pm: Any release notes to record now? If nothing else, I'll draft a short entry: "performance: improved KV cache eviction lowering average per-token latency in long conversations".

alex_chung: That phrasing works. Add a note about router header rewrite and no customer-facing API changes.

deploy-bot: deploy:success: canary 30% stable at 2088881350

tim_ops: Final decision/ops summary:
- Proceed to 60% at 10:00 UTC unless any new alerts.
- Rollback rules as posted.
- If capacity in EU forces cross-region routing, notify #customer-success to coordinate support messages.

alex_chung: Thanks team. I'll open a follow-up thread for the 60% step. If anyone sees anything odd, @here and escalate immediately. :rocket:
